Game Overview

Tom Runner is a action title where dash through a pulsating city as Tom, the nimble raccoon, eluding persistent police in exhilarating, fast-paced action. Utilize intuitive touch controls to maneuver through vibrant urban challenges. Collect coins, harness power-ups, and master slick evasive techniques to survive increasingly intense pursuits in this visually stunning adventure.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Tom Runner is easy to pick up. Dash through a pulsating city as Tom, the nimble raccoon, eluding persistent police in exhilarating, fast-paced action.
